q: According to Biot-Savart law, the magnetic field dB due to a current element is proportional to
why: dB = (mu0/4 pi) x I dl sin(theta)/r^2.

q: The Biot-Savart law is considered the magnetic analogue of which electrostatics law?
why: Both give field as inverse-square law from a source element, with mu0/4pi playing the role of k.

q: The magnetic field at the centre of a circular current loop of radius r carrying current I is
why: Standard result from integrating Biot-Savart law over the loop.
